about: v82s shared skill-tree math for every class (see docs/SKILLTREE-TUNING.md). Each data/skilltrees-<cls>.json is merged over this file: class keys win, strings merge key by key. Tune the point rhythm, rank curve and 41-50 damage band here once for all five classes.

points.about: Tree points: 1 at level 1, +1 per level to 50 (50), plus 1 every 5 Paragon levels (20 by Paragon 100). 70 total. Points are derived from level and Paragon, so they can never exceed 70.

rank.about: Rank of every unlocked skill in a tree = round(min(points,40) / perRank), at least 1, at most max. 40 points maxes a tree's skills (rank 20). Points past 40 do not raise rank. Gear +skills only adds to skills that are already unlocked.

damageBand.about: Points 41-50: damage only (+pct per point to that tree's skills). No rank, area, stat or utility gain.

strings.allUnlocked: All 8 unlocked. Points 41–50 add damage only.
strings.noPoints: No points to spend. One comes with each level.
strings.oneUltimate: Only one tree can reach its ultimate.
strings.notice: Your skills now grow in trees. Every point is back to spend.
strings.noticeShort: Your skills now grow in trees. Every point is back to spend.
